title: Backup Service Terms for Web Hosting Plans: Frequency, Retention and Restore Fees
content:
### Backup service terms — Web Hosting Plans

| Tier | Automatic backup frequency | Restore point kept, calendar days | Customer restores without a fee | Fee per support-performed restore, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Starter | weekly | 28 | No | 19.99 |
| Harborline Plus | weekly | 28 | No | 19.99 |
| Harborline Pro | daily | 30 | Yes | 0.00 |
| Harborline Business | daily | 30 | Yes | 0.00 |
| Harborline Cloud 4 | daily | 45 | Yes | 0.00 |
| Harborline Cloud 8 | daily | 45 | Yes | 0.00 |

- **Frequency** is how often automatic backups of the plan run: weekly or daily.
- **Retention** is the number of calendar days a backup restore point is kept.
- **Self-service restore** states whether the customer may restore backups without a fee.
- **Restore fee** is the fee per support-performed restore from backup; it is 0.00 where restores are free.

**Comparison of two tiers (illustration).** On Harborline Plus a support-performed restore carries the 19.99 fee shown above; on Harborline Pro the customer restores without a fee and the fee column reads 0.00.
